agent.client: Claude Code 2.1.278, headless, one session for the whole take
agent.transport: Conn MCP stdio server (conn mcp --agent-id claude-code --tools static)

environment: Ubuntu; native Conn backend and the actual Svelte frontend through the browser test adapter; a disposable OpenSSH server in a local container bound to 127.0.0.1 with a synthetic password; default policy; local Bash shell integration active

capture.method: Chrome DevTools Page.startScreencast, JPEG 95, 1200x540 CSS pixels at 2x
capture.editing: One continuous take. No frame in which the picture changes was removed or reordered. Spans in which the screen did not change were shortened: to 0.45s while the agent was thinking, up to 3.2s while a card waited for the human. After the take ends on a still screen, its last frame is held for 4.6s while the agent's reply is shown.

humanRole: Automated by the operator through real browser key and mouse events: typed ssh staging and the password, clicked Allow, Approve and Deny on the actual cards, typed ./api.sh unlock.
visiblePrompts: The API on staging is down. Look at my Conn terminal and get it running again.
I cleared the stale lock myself, so keep the cache. Read the terminal and continue.
agentBrief: The agent was given a prepared brief that listed the plan, including clearing the cache with rm -rf cache/ when it found the stale lock, and told it to stop if denied or if the human took the keyboard. The wrong turn is staged; the agent's tool calls, wording and stated reasons are its own.

cards.statedReason: Show the current status of the API service (read-only)
cards.label: Review command in this shell/remote environment

cards.statedReason: Show the last 3 lines of api.log (read-only) to find why the API stopped
cards.label: Review command in this shell/remote environment

cards.statedReason: Delete the entire cache/ directory, including the stale index.lock blocking startup
cards.label: Review command in this shell/remote environment

cards.statedReason: Start the API service via api.sh (cache and lock already handled)
cards.label: Review command in this shell/remote environment

cards.statedReason: Run the API health check (read-only) to confirm the service is up
cards.label: Review command in this shell/remote environment

agentReplies: The `rm -rf cache/` command was denied, so I'm stopping here without retrying or trying another route.
The API is back up on :8080. `./api.sh health` returns `{"status": "ok", "cache": "warm"}`, the cache is intact, and I've released control.
messageCards: The cards that show the human's prompts and the agent's final reply are editorial graphics, not a recording of the agent client. The English text is verbatim (the prompts as sent, the reply as written by the agent); the Korean film shows translations of the same messages.
